summary.intent: Finish and update the registry-url PR (#459), then start a new fix so each npm publish in the release flow gets its own confirmation window instead of sharing one.
summary.outcome: Updated PR #459's title and body, then created branch fix/npm-confirmation-window with changes to release_execution.rs and release_simulator.rs, a new regression test, and a changeset. Workspace clippy and tests were run, and the branch was committed and pushed; the PR number was looked up but the result isn't shown.

repo: Release execution logic lives in crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/release_execution.rs and is exercised by a simulator in release_simulator.rs, which has its own clock/pause/issue/look_cost machinery.
Changes require a changeset file in .changeset/ (e.g. npm-confirmation-window-per-publish.md).
Commit messages follow conventional commits with scope, e.g. fix(release): ...
Pre-push verification is cargo fmt, cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings, and cargo test --workspace.
The repo uses `entire trail link <id>` to associate a branch/commit with a trail, and the work is in a worktree under .claude/worktrees/macos-15-runners.

code.finding: Contains ConfirmationWave-related logic that determines the npm confirmation window; this was inspected and modified so each publish has its own window.
Additional confirmation window handling that was read and changed as part of the per-publish window fix.
Simulator code for publish/confirmation timing, used to write a test that reproduces the late-confirmation scenario.

workflow: Verify a new regression test actually fails on the old logic by saving the fix as a patch, reverting the file, running the test, then re-applying the patch.
Use a throwaway Python script run with `python3 -I` to apply multi-site edits, then cargo fmt and a targeted test filter before running the whole workspace.
Use gh pr list --head <branch> --json number to find the PR number and gh pr edit --body-file to update PR descriptions.
Branch new work from origin/main with `git switch -c <name> --no-track origin/main` to avoid inheriting an upstream.
